compatibility.notes: Pressure Test is the public capability name for the existing Grill/grilling lineage; aliases do not replace asset IDs.

do_not_use_when.text: The dependent uncertainty exceeds one session and requires multi-session Wayfinding
The blocker is missing repository evidence the agent can retrieve

use_when.text: A consequential plan or design decision can be settled inside one reliable working session
The unresolved decisions are bounded enough to enumerate as a dependency-aware frontier

evidence_outputs.description: Settled decisions and rationale suitable for downstream work.
evidence_outputs.name: decision_record

inputs.description: Plan, design, or decision surface whose consequential ambiguity must be resolved.
inputs.name: decision_scope

inputs.description: Recoverable facts, prior decisions, constraints, or source material.
inputs.name: existing_evidence

outputs.description: Resolved decisions with tradeoffs and rationale.
outputs.name: settled_decisions

outputs.description: Unknowns that remain or require research, prototyping, or broader Wayfinding.
outputs.name: remaining_frontier

preconditions.description: The unresolved decision tree appears capable of meaningful progress within one session.

capability.purpose: Resolve consequential ambiguity that can be settled within one reliable working session.

requirements.description: The current unresolved decision frontier is recomputed after consequential answers.
Research, prototype, or repository questions are split out instead of forced into guesses.
The result either reaches shared understanding or identifies the correct escalation.
